meta.strategy: The PAS strategy focuses on the 'Infrastructure Ceiling' as the core problem, agitating the economic and environmental paralysis caused by legacy transit systems, and positioning Bluetone as the leapfrog solution that harmonizes autonomous tech with local African regulatory landscapes.

content.headline: LEAPFROGGING THE INFRASTRUCTURE CEILING

steps.title: The Infrastructure Ceiling
steps.description: Africa's rapid urbanization is colliding with stagnant transport infrastructure. Conventional transit solutions are too slow to deploy and too rigid to adapt, leaving millions disconnected from opportunity.

steps.title: The Cost of Stagnation
steps.description: Every day spent waiting for traditional pavement is a day of lost GDP, rising carbon emissions, and hazardous road conditions. We aren't just losing time; we are losing the future of our cities.

steps.title: The Bluetone Leap
steps.description: Bluetone bridges the gap. By deploying electric, autonomous transit and law-abiding robots that respect local regulations, we create a future-proof ecosystem that is sustainable and culturally adaptive.

content.closing_statement: Join the movement toward 50% accessibility across Africa by 2035. The future is electric, autonomous, and uniquely ours.
